BiblicalUsage: Bachiyn is a watch-tower of besiegers — the tower the enemy builds against a city. Isaiah says the Chaldeans shall set up their towers against Tyre, and the city that trusted in its walls will watch the enemy build higher.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the besieger's tower is the picture of pride's end: the city that trusted its own walls watches the enemy build above them.
